name: Zain Rizvi
title: ML engineer and builder.
tagline: Forecasting systems, AI tools and robotics that ship.
about: I am a recent Honours BSc graduate from the University of Toronto, with a double major in Computer Science and Mathematics. My work sits between statistics and software: forecasting systems, machine learning models and the tooling that makes them usable.

I have shipped production forecasting at a national logistics company, built a robotics policy with language conditioning, and written everything from a 2D light simulator in C to a platformer in assembly. I work best on small teams where one person owns a problem end to end.
